title: The First Oath Sparks
description: Oath Under Thunder: The First Oath Sparks unfolds across storm-slick rune-iron bridge with oath-stones, broken railings, and thunder channels built into the span, pushing the one active Asgardian Titan to convert endurance into decisive counterpressure.
lore: The First Oath Sparks advances the Storm-Oath Covenant arc: the Gate tries to harvest Asgardian vows, while Valhalla law insists courage must remain chosen responsibility.
terrain: storm-slick rune-iron bridge with oath-stones, broken railings, and thunder channels built into the span

objectives.primary: Complete The First Oath Sparks with one active Titan while reading storm-slick rune-iron bridge with oath-stones, broken railings, and thunder channels built into the span and preserving faction doctrine.
optional: Keep your active Titan above 40% integrity
Trigger at least two Oathbound counterattacks
Trigger at least one Momentum or Divinity decision before victory

specialRules: Storm Oath: Momentum surges after decisive movement through exposed lightning lanes.
Oathbound Guard: Titans that survive damage near oath-stones empower their next committed strike.
Oathbound: surviving damage strengthens the next committed strike.
Solo Titanic Scale: one active Titan occupies the tactical focus; enemies, elites, and bosses scale around that single presence.
victoryConditions: Complete The First Oath Sparks with one active Titan while reading storm-slick rune-iron bridge with oath-stones, broken railings, and thunder channels built into the span and preserving faction doctrine.

stars.one: Primary completed under severe integrity or turn pressure

activeTitanDesignNotes: Balanced for the standard one active Titan; nonstandard modes require explicit Creator approval.
